lesson.title: Exclude Cancelled Items During Order Creation
lesson.when: the customer explicitly asks to exclude or remove a cancelled item from the final order
lesson.do: verify the updated cart contents and create the order containing only the requested active items
lesson.otherwise: express uncertainty about the updated cart composition and ask the customer to clarify the items to include before proceeding
